headline: Public hearing on parking requirements at 61-69 Suffolk Street and a fence height request at 230-232 Beech Street.
summary: Hearings also cover zone changes for comprehensive plan revisions and BG sign rules. The meeting also includes marijuana facility reviews at 73 Sargeant Street and 1 Cabot Street.
items: Special permit to reduce parking requirements at 61-69 Suffolk St, Bryan Taub (SP 2026-14)
